marker.description: A pin with a green head is inserted into the red vessel (aorta) near the arch.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is inserted into the main red vessel descending from the arch, which represents the thoracic aorta.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is a direct branch of the aortic arch?
supporting_question.explanation: The left subclavian artery is the third and final branch of the aortic arch. The right subclavian and left common carotid are branches of the brachiocephalic trunk.
